verifies.G097-C4: a junction table with only two foreign key columns yields @ManyToMany with @JoinTable on one side (Book, naming book_tags) and @ManyToMany(mappedBy) on the other (Tag). All three tables are selected. The @JoinTable also names its join and inverse join columns explicitly (book_id, tag_id): the JPA defaults would derive the inverse column from the attribute name (tags_id), so the claim's @JoinTable is only correct with them; the expectation therefore matches the prefix @JoinTable(name = "book_tags" and not a closing parenthesis.

note: books/tags/book_tags SQL with a two-column junction table.
